name: Kunsthandwerklicher Weihnachtsmarkt Frohnau
old: Teilweise Kopfsteinpflaster auf öffentlichem Straßengelände. Frohnauer Weihnachtsmarkt- Zauberhafte Adventsstimmung im Norden Reinickendorfs. Rund 120 Kunsthandwerkerinnen und Kunsthandwerker präsentieren ihre mit Liebe gefertigten Unikate – von feinem Schmuck und handgedrehter Keramik bis hin zu weihnachtlichen Dekorationen und kleinen Aufmerksamkeiten zum Verschenken. Besucherinnen und Besucher schätzen besonders die familiäre Atmosphäre, das ausgewählte Angebot und die liebevoll dekorierten Stände. Zwischen Glühweinduft, Lichterglanz und weihnachtlicher Musik lässt sich hier entspannt flanieren und das passende Geschenk für die Liebsten finden. Keine Handelsware, kein Bühnenprogramm.

name: Weihnachtsmarkt im Paul Gerhardt Stift
old: Zugang zu Gelände ist barrierefrei. Zum fünten mal nun verwandeln wir das Stiftsgelände in einen funkelnden Weihnachtsmarkt! Tauchen Sie gemeinsam mit Freunden und Familie in die festliche Stimmung ein und lassen Sie sich von einem zauberhaften Programm begeistern. Ob Groß oder Klein – bei uns erwartet Sie Herzlichkeit und jede Menge Weihnachtszauber und ein gemütlicher Weihnachtsmarkt in einer tollen Kulisse. Freuen Sie sich auf: Kunsthandwerksstände, Weihnachtliche Leckereien (Grill, Glühwein, internationale Speisen), Musikalische Unterhaltung , Zauberhafte Überraschung, Infostände, Himmlischer Besuch, Aktivitäten für Kinder und vieles mehr… 18 Uhr Musikalische Vesper zum 2. Advent. Das Stiftscafé ist in diesem Jahr geöffnet und bietet vegetarische Leckereien an. Darüber hinaus gibt es im Paul Gerhardt Saal einen Kuchen- und Kaffeeverkauf. Der Weihnachtsmarkt endet um 18 Uhr mit einem Gottesdienst in unserer Kirche.

name: Adventsmarkt im Bergmannkiez
old: Außen- und Innenbereich der Pflegeeinrichtung. Gemeinsam in die Adventszeit zu starten: Der Adventsmarkt im Pflegewohnheim „Am Kreuzberg“ lädt in Kooperation mit dem Mühlenhaupt Museum (schräg gegenüber) zu einem stimmungsvollen vorweihnachtlichen Nachmittag ein. Besucher:innen erwartet ein abwechslungsreiches Programm für Groß und Klein – mit Musik, Tanz und vielen Mitmachangeboten. Freuen Sie sich auf ein festliches Programm im Haus und auf dem Außengelände: Die Tanzrevue „Minis“ und „Teenies“ von La Caminada, der Beats and Roots Chor sowie der Koala Choir Berlin sorgen am Nachmittag für musikalische und Höhepunkte. Auch draußen gibt es viel zu entdecken: Kinderkarussell, Streichelzoo, Kunsthandwerk und weitere Mitmachangebote laden Groß und Klein zum Verweilen ein. Für das leibliche Wohl ist mit Glühwein, Bratwurst, Burgern, Crêpes und Kaltgetränken gesorgt.

Das erwartet euch: Liebevoll gestaltete Stände mit handgemachten Geschenkideen und weihnachtlicher Dekoration. Schlemmen & Genießen: Frischer Glühwein, heißer Kakao und klassische Bratwurst und viele Weihnachtsleckereien, Buntes Bühnenprogramm, Kinderanimation. Kommt vorbei und erlebt besinnliche Stunden mit der ganzen Familie! Der Eintritt ist frei!

name: Kunsthandwerklicher Weihnachtsmarkt Frohnau
old: Partly cobbled on public roads. Frohnau Christmas Market – a magical Advent atmosphere in the north of Reinickendorf. Around 120 craftspeople present their lovingly crafted, one-of-a-kind pieces – from delicate jewellery and hand-thrown ceramics to Christmas decorations and small gifts. Visitors particularly appreciate the cosy, family-friendly atmosphere, the carefully curated selection and the lovingly decorated stalls. Amidst the scent of mulled wine, the twinkling lights and festive music, you can stroll around at your leisure and find the perfect gift for your loved ones. No commercial goods, no stage performances.

name: Kunsthandwerklicher Weihnachtsmarkt am Mexikoplatz
old: Cobbled streets. During the festive season, the arts and crafts Christmas market at Mexikoplatz offers a very special experience on all four Sundays of Advent. Over 90 talented craftspeople showcase their unique, handmade creations. Visitors can look forward to exquisite jewellery, fine ceramics, cosy knitted jumpers and hats, cheerful Christmas cards and much more. Everything is crafted with great attention to detail. Only one-off pieces, no mass-produced goods. This is where you’ll still find special gift ideas! Please note: Dates are subject to change, depending on the progress of the underground construction work.

name: Berliner Weihnachtszeit vor dem Roten Rathaus in Berlin Mitte
old: The event is organised in such a way that people with disabilities can attend without difficulty or the need for assistance. | Visitors can enjoy a festive outing free of charge. Younger guests can explore the Fairytale Forest by train; a life-size Christian nativity scene is on display, and a unique Erzgebirge nativity scene featuring hand-carved historical figures can be admired; an illuminated Christmas tree at the entrance opposite the Red Town Hall is the perfect spot for selfies; along the promenade by St Mary’s Church, visitors can watch craftspeople creating their works; and the flying Father Christmas can be marvelled at three times a day, at 4.30 pm, 6.30 pm and 8.30 pm. | You can watch people ice-skating on the circular ice rink | Ice-skating times – daily (from the start of the market) | Session: 12.00 (Sat & Sun from 11.15) – 13.30 | Session: 14.00 – 15.30 | Session: 16.00 – 17.30 | Session: 18.00 – 7.30 pm | Session 8.00 pm – 9.30 pm | Price per session €5.00 | 1 pair of ice skates per session €3.00 | Skating aid (penguin, bear) per session €5.00 plus deposit.

name: Adventsmarkt im Rathaus Charlottenburg, aus den Werkstätten der Beschäftigungsträger
old: The lift at Otto-Suhr-Allee 98 is situated to the left of the library entrance. | Creative items made from wood and fabric, candles and waffles from the workshops run by employment organisations.

name: Wintermarkt Schlossplatz Berlin Mitte
old: Level flooring, no risk of tripping over cables, wide aisles, non-slip ramps at the catering marquee, toilet facilities with a ramp, and accessible car parks nearby. The Humboldt Forum is illuminated by lights, with a free programme of artists; the Humboldt Forum combines architecture and history and, with its winter market, offers a wide variety of culinary delights. The winter market offers its younger visitors a historic Ferris wheel, a small children’s carousel and a chain-driven swing ride.

name: Romantischer Weihnachtsmarkt
old: It’s a special Saturday during Advent. At the Lebenshilfe centre and out in the garden. For young and old alike in the Wedding neighbourhood. The market stalls offer: lovely gift ideas, made with love. Handcrafted and homemade items. Arts and crafts, and much more. Hot waffles, crêpes, biscuits and cakes. Children’s punch, hot chocolate and mulled wine. Grilled bratwurst, burgers, kale and other treats. With music from the barrel organ player and a visit from Father Christmas and Mrs Christmas. The Nogat Singers choir will be performing from 4 pm.

name: Weihnachtsmarkt auf der Dicken Linda
old: The market is held in a square at ground level. For the ninth year running, a Christmas market will take place on Kranoldplatz in Neukölln on the second Saturday of Advent, from 10 am to 6 pm. On all other Saturdays of the year, the DIEDICKE LINDA weekly market is held here from 10 am to 4 pm; this is also organised by diemarktplaner.

name: HEISSA HOLZMARKT WINTERFESTIVAL
old: Unrestricted accessibility

name: Weihnachtsmarkt Bernau
old: On Tuesday 8 December, from 2.00 pm to 6.00 pm, we will be holding our Christmas market as a ‘quiet market’. Our event is aimed at people with autism or sensitivity to stimuli, families with young children, and anyone who would like to enjoy a peaceful Advent atmosphere.

name: Weihnachtsmarkt im Paul Gerhardt Stift
old: The site is fully accessible. For the fifth time now, we’re transforming the abbey grounds into a sparkling Christmas market! Immerse yourself in the festive atmosphere with friends and family and be enchanted by a magical programme. Whether young or old – you can expect a warm welcome, plenty of Christmas magic and a cosy Christmas market set against a stunning backdrop. Look forward to: craft stalls, festive treats (barbecue, mulled wine, international dishes), musical entertainment, a magical surprise, information stands, a heavenly visitor, activities for children and much more… 6.00 pm: Musical vespers for the second Sunday of Advent. The Stiftscafé is open this year and offers vegetarian treats. There will also be a cake and coffee stall in the Paul Gerhardt Hall. The Christmas market ends at 6 pm with a church service in our church.

name: Umwelt- und Weihnachtsmarkt in der Sophienstraße
old: Discover original work by artists and designers and find gifts you won’t see everywhere. The market’s idea won first prize in an environmental competition in 1996. It’s still one of Berlin’s most distinctive Christmas markets.

name: Adventsmarkt im Bergmannkiez
old: Outside and inside the care home. Kicking off the Advent season together: the Advent market at the ‘Am Kreuzberg’ care home, in collaboration with the Mühlenhaupt Museum (diagonally opposite), invites you to enjoy an atmospheric pre-Christmas afternoon. Visitors can look forward to a varied programme for young and old alike – featuring music, dance and plenty of hands-on activities. Look forward to a festive programme both indoors and in the grounds: the ‘Minis’ and ‘Teenies’ dance revue by La Caminada, the Beats and Roots Choir and the Koala Choir Berlin will provide musical highlights throughout the afternoon. There’s plenty to discover outside too: a children’s carousel, a petting zoo, arts and crafts, and other hands-on activities invite young and old alike to linger. Refreshments will be available, including mulled wine, bratwurst, burgers, crêpes and cold drinks.

name: ://glühweingarten
old: Mulled wine, fire pit, vegan food, music in the marquee

name: freiheit fünfzehn Weihnachtsmarkt für Groß & Klein
old: All at ground level; steps have ramps; accessible toilet. Charming stalls selling handmade goods, delicious food and drink, a children’s programme featuring Father Christmas, a fairy-tale hut and much, much more

name: Winter am THF
old: Winter market at the THF TOWER at Tempelhof Airport, featuring a food court, handmade design items and gift ideas, festive music, family entertainment and a large-scale Christmas carol sing-along in the main hall. Wheelchair access.

name: Adventsmarkt 2026
old: Visitors are asked to use public transport. Please also note the changes to the traffic arrangements on the site!

name: Weihnachtsmarkt Wintershopping
old: Paved pedestrian zone, at ground level!

name: Weihnachtsmarkt am Schloss Charlottenburg
old: Disabled parking spaces and disabled toilets, ramps at the pagoda tents

name: Weihnachtsbasar der schwedischen Gemeinde "Lichterkönigin Lucia"
old: There is a separate entrance with a lift. The whole Christmas market is outdoors and at ground level. However, about a third of it is on grass. In slippery or wet weather, this may present some challenges. Admission: €2 per person. Free for children under 12. Please leave dogs at home. Lucia will be singing with her choir on Saturday and Sunday at 4 pm and 5 pm respectively. A warm welcome to you all!

name: Weihnachtsmarkt Weddingmarkt
old: The Wedding Market becomes a Christmas market: every Sunday in Advent and the Saturday before Christmas, from 11 am to 7 pm. Leopoldplatz market featuring handmade art, design and street food, with a bonfire and supporting programme | On all four Sundays in Advent, the Wedding Market will be aglow with winter splendour – right in the heart of the Wedding district on Leopoldplatz, in front of the historic Schinkel Church (Old Nazareth Church). This year, you can place some very special gifts under the Christmas tree, as a visit to the festive Wedding Market promises exceptional art, design and a genuine passion for craftsmanship. Many Wedding-based brands will be showcasing the high-quality diversity of this vibrant neighbourhood out on Leopoldplatz. | Visitors can look forward to around 100 stalls featuring design, photography, ceramics, illustrations, paintings, home accessories, furniture, jewellery, fashion, spirits, teas and much more. | A total of around 250 different exhibitors take part across four dates, ensuring that every visit is varied and well worth the trip. | There’s also international street food on offer – from Spätzle and raclette to Asian dishes, Mexican tacos, vegetarian options and even crispy waffles – there’s something for every discerning palate. Mulled wine and a bonfire with a free ‘bread-on-a-stick station’ for younger visitors create a festive atmosphere. The whole event is accompanied by an artistic programme of side events featuring music and many other surprises. | As always, entry to the market is free. In the run-up to the event, unique Weddingmarkt items will be given away via social media as part of an Advent calendar. Accessibility information: ground-level venue, direct access to the underground and public transport network, with lifts.

name: Oh du Schöneweide
old: The event venues at “Oh du Schöneweide” are largely accessible to people with disabilities. To enable us to make the best possible arrangements for your visit and provide assistance where needed, we ask guests with reduced mobility to register briefly in advance by emailing support@oh-du-schoeneweide.de. “Oh du Schöneweide” combines a Christmas dinner and a Christmas market into an all-inclusive experience at the WHITE Spreelounge, right on the banks of the Spree. Food and drinks are included in the ticket price. The celebrations take place in heated indoor areas. Christmas dinner opening hours: Wed–Fri, 18:00–23:00

name: Lichterfest Rudow
old: Rudow Festival of Lights – A festive experience for the whole family. On 23 November 2026, the Rudow Working Group warmly invites you to the ‘Rudow Festival of Lights’ to join in switching on the festive Christmas lights in the district. Enjoy the magic of the festive season in the festively lit courtyard of the Old Village School in Rudow. This new tradition has been launched by the Rudow Working Group and promises a wonderful start to the Christmas season – with free entry! Visitors can look forward to an atmospherically decorated courtyard that brings the anticipation of the festive season to life. Set in the heart of charming Old Rudow, the festival offers a varied programme that has something for everyone.

name: Berliner Weihnachtsrummel 2026 am Alice-Salomon-Platz
old: Christmas spirit, fairground fun and a festive atmosphere right in the heart of Berlin-Hellersdorf! From 25 November to 27 December 2026, Alice-Salomon-Platz will be transformed into a magical Christmas fair for the whole family. Here, a cosy Christmas spirit meets entertainment and plenty of fun at the fair. Whether you’re looking to stroll around, marvel at the sights, savour the atmosphere or simply spend a lovely afternoon or evening together – the Berlin Christmas Fair offers the perfect opportunity to enjoy the Advent and Christmas season in a relaxed way.

name: Weihnachtsmarkt Königs Wusterhausen
old: The church square is transformed into a festively lit Christmas village! Look forward to three atmospheric days featuring a varied programme of stage performances, culinary delights, handcrafted treasures and plenty of wonderful moments for the whole family. There’s also plenty for our youngest visitors to discover: a children’s carousel and other surprises are sure to make the little ones’ eyes light up. Come along, soak up the special atmosphere and spend a lovely pre-Christmas weekend with family and friends in Königs Wusterhausen! Free entry!

name: Weihnachtsmarkt Bölschestraße
old: Three days full of lights, treats and Christmas spirit! From 27 to 29 November 2026, Bölschestraße will become the festive heart of Friedrichshagen. A beautifully lit Christmas market invites you to marvel, stroll, feast and linger. Here’s what’s in store for you: a varied programme of stage performances, special culinary delights, lovingly selected handcrafted goods, a children’s carousel for our little guests and, of course, the odd surprise or two! Whether with family, friends or simply for a leisurely Christmas stroll – here you can leave the daily grind behind and get into the spirit of the most wonderful time of the year together. Do pop along, enjoy the festive atmosphere and make this Christmas market your personal highlight of the Advent season! Free entry!

name: Potsdamer Weihnachtszauber
old: Set against the unique backdrop of Potsdam’s historic city centre, the Potsdam Christmas Magic invites guests to enjoy an unforgettable run-up to Christmas. There is plenty to discover at the approximately 250 stalls, where you can experience Christmas with all your senses. On Luisenplatz, guests will find a village of white pagodas featuring arts and crafts, delicatessen goods and the Jazz & Swing stage. At the Brandenburg Gate stands a nostalgic children’s carousel, as well as the city’s largest Christmas tree. Brandenburger Straße, with its many shops, is the perfect place for a pre-Christmas stroll and also serves as the main thoroughfare leading to the main area on Bassinplatz. At Bassinplatz North, visitors can look forward to the ice rink, children’s carousels, the large Erzgebirge hut and Santa’s hut; you’ll also find Sternengasse here, with its club and newcomer huts. At Bassinplatz South, you’ll find, amongst other things, the giant Ferris wheel and the main stage. A varied programme of stage performances will entertain young and old alike across two stages.

name: Weihnachtsmarkt Tempelhofer Hafen
old: Whether to round off a day’s Christmas shopping or as a relaxing family outing at the weekend – this Christmas market offers plenty of opportunities for special moments and combines a festive, contemplative atmosphere, live music and the perfect setting for a successful Christmas shopping trip. Enjoy the festive atmosphere, the musical highlights at the weekend and the convenience of being close to the shops. There’s plenty for the little ones to enjoy too. Visit our Christmas market on the forecourt of the shopping centre at Tempelhofer Hafen.

name: Rudower Weihnachtsmeile
old: When the scent of mulled wine and roasted almonds wafts through Alt Rudow, it’s time once again for the Rudow Christmas Fair. On 5 and 6 December 2026, the Rudow Working Group invites you to a festive weekend centred on Christmas, shared experiences and cosy moments. A festive experience mile for the whole family will spring up around Alt Rudow and Krokusstraße. Amongst festively decorated stalls, arts and crafts, gift ideas and culinary treats are waiting to be discovered. Whether it’s sweet waffles and roasted almonds or a hearty bratwurst – there’s something to satisfy Christmas appetites big and small. Entertainment is provided by a varied stage programme featuring music and special moments for young and old alike. The Rudow Christmas Mile is more than just a Christmas market: it’s a meeting place for families, friends and neighbours to enjoy the build-up to the festive season together and escape the daily grind for a few hours. Free entry!

name: Weihnachtsmarkt Hallen am Borsigturm
old: A festive atmosphere, indulgence and a family experience. The Christmas market on the forecourt of the Borsighallen, running from 23 November to 30 December 2026, combines the festive spirit of Advent with shopping and entertainment. Lovingly decorated stalls invite visitors to enjoy sweet and savoury winter delicacies, whilst live music creates the perfect Christmas atmosphere. Families will also find plenty to enjoy: the large children’s carousel is sure to bring a sparkle to the eyes of our youngest visitors. Whether as a festive way to round off your Christmas shopping or as a cosy family outing – here, the Advent season becomes a truly special experience. Companies are also warmly invited to join us at our stalls to celebrate together.

name: Weihnachtsmarkt Ludwigsfelde
old: Three days of Christmas spirit right in the heart of Ludwigsfelde! The square around the town hall is transformed into a festive gathering place for the whole family. A large Christmas tree creates a festive atmosphere, alongside a colourful programme of stage entertainment for young and old, festive food and drink, delicious treats, children’s attractions for the little visitors to the Christmas market, and plenty of local clubs with their own stalls and offerings. Whether you’re taking a leisurely stroll through the market, enjoying the run-up to Christmas with your family, or getting into the festive spirit with mulled wine and treats – the Ludwigsfelde Christmas market invites you to linger and celebrate!

name: Weihnachtsmarkt Alt-Buckow
old: Festive neighbourhood magic in Alt-Buckow: On the first weekend of Advent, Hauptstadtkultur, in collaboration with the ‘Das sympathische Buckow e.V.’ association, is presenting the Alt-Buckow Christmas market. Here’s what’s in store for you: lovingly designed stalls with handmade gift ideas and festive decorations. Feasting & enjoyment: fresh mulled wine, hot chocolate, classic bratwurst and plenty of Christmas treats, a varied stage programme, and children’s entertainment. Come along and enjoy a cosy time with the whole family! Admission is free!

name: Weihnacht to go im Kranoldkiez
old: The Christmas market takes place in the streets around Kranoldplatz. The stalls lining the streets are accessible to all. The local community association Mein LiLa e.V. warmly invites you to Lichterfelde-Ost in the Kranoldkiez neighbourhood. On Saturday, 12 December 2026, between 2 pm and 7 pm, we will be transforming the streets around Kranoldplatz into a cosy Christmas market with a regional flavour. As well as mulled wine, festive treats and a wide selection of stallholders, there will be – as every year – the brass band in front of the Blickfang opticians, as well as many other musical performances at various locations along the route. In addition, many shops will extend their opening hours until 7 pm. The event is taking place with the kind support of the Steglitz-Zehlendorf Economic Development Agency.

name: Potsdamer Schokoladenmarkt
old: An accessible toilet is located in the State Parliament building on the Alter Markt. From 4 to 20 December 2026, the Alter Markt in Potsdam will once again be transformed into a paradise for chocolate lovers and connoisseurs. The Potsdam Chocolate Market is all about chocolate, sweet specialities and special moments of indulgence in a festive atmosphere. Selected manufacturers, chocolatiers and retailers will be presenting a diverse selection of chocolates, pralines, truffles and other sweet delicacies. The range is complemented by savoury dishes, winter drinks and gift ideas for the festive season. The historic Alter Markt, with St Nicholas’ Church, the Barberini Museum and the Potsdam Museum, provides a very special backdrop for the event. Admission: free

name: weihnachtsmarkt pankow
old: The Christmas market is located at street level and is wheelchair accessible.

name: Adventsmarkt Hermannswerder
old: The market takes place outdoors; the grassy area may be uneven. Accessible toilets are available in the Hoffbauer Conference Centre. On the island of Hermannswerder, far from the pre-Christmas hustle and bustle yet right in the heart of Potsdam, Advent reveals its contemplative side. On 6 December, the Hoffbauer Foundation invites you to its Advent market, a favourite with families. Bathed in romantic lighting, colourful market stalls beckon visitors to enjoy and explore. The Hoffbauer Foundation’s institutions and regional craftspeople offer home-baked goods, children’s handicrafts, festive decorations, fine jewellery, all manner of delicacies, arts and crafts, and gift ideas. The atmospheric market begins with a musical service at 2.00 pm in the candlelit Inselkirche. Young and old will gather round the fire at 4.00 pm for a sing-along. And at 5.30 pm, the choirs of the Evangelisches Gymnasium Hermannswerder and the Camerata Vocale invite you to a concert entitled ‘O Magnum mysterium’ in the church.

name: Ökumenischer Adventsbasar
old: All stalls in the parish garden are at ground level; toilets are accessible via stairs

name: Weihnachtsmarkt in der Linde
old: As well as the stairs, there are ramps, and there is an accessible toilet in the community centre. You can look forward to arts and crafts, books, bric-a-brac, a café and, of course, savoury snacks and mulled wine. At the same time, our nursery is holding an open day!

name: Adventsmarkt auf der Domäne Dahlem
old: The entire outdoor area on the estate is wheelchair accessible. However, parts of the estate’s courtyard feature historic cobblestones. A disabled toilet is located in the country inn. On all four Advent weekends, the historic courtyard of the Domäne Dahlem is transformed into a festive Advent market. Look forward to market stalls offering a selection of arts and crafts, a Christmas programme for children, winter tractor rides, organic mulled wine from the winegrower, and a pan of kale fresh from the Domäne’s fields straight onto your plate.

name: Kunsthandwerklicher Advent am Karl-August-Platz
old: The square is accessible to people with disabilities from all sides.

name: Kunsthandwerklicher Advent in der Leonhardtstrasse
old: Takes place on the pavement.

name: Weihnachten in Westend
old: Takes place on the pavement.

name: WEINachten am Ludwig-Beck-Platz
old: The square is accessible to people with disabilities from all sides.

name: Weihnachtsmarkt an der Kaiser-Wilhelm-Gedächtniskirche 2026
old: An accessible Christmas market. Around 100 festively decorated stalls, sparkling fairy lights and a unique wintry backdrop create an atmosphere that warms the heart and soul. Whether it’s handicrafts from around the world, delicious treats or simply a mug of mulled wine with friends – here you can enjoy the Advent season in all its facets. A special highlight this year, too, is the approximately 400-metre-long carpet of lights by Andreas Boehlke, which transforms the sky above the market into a sea of lights. The experience is complemented by cosy mulled wine gardens as well as covered seating and standing areas, which invite you to warm up and sit together. Free entry!

name: Der "etwas andere" Weihnachtsmarkt im Naturparkzentrum
old: Craft and hands-on activity stalls are at ground level or accessible via a ramp; a wheelchair lift leads to the attic. A disabled toilet is available. Some of the market stalls outside are only accessible via the lawn. Unlike traditional Christmas markets, this isn’t just about browsing and feasting: visitors can get creative themselves and make their own Christmas gifts. Whether it’s felting, making Advent arrangements, candle-making or silk painting – here, visitors can create small, unique items that are far more personal than anything you could buy. The Flämingladen shop and the market stalls also offer regional gift ideas, handicrafts and culinary specialities from the area. A particular highlight is the torchlight walk to Rabenstein Castle, which takes place at 4 pm each day.

name: Weihnachtsmarkt in der Abenteueroase
old: The Christmas market takes place in the outdoor area of the youth leisure centre and is largely accessible. However, the toilet facilities are not accessible. All stalls are run by clubs and scout groups, as well as by children’s and youth organisations. As well as alcohol- and meat-free Christmas treats, there are also arts and crafts, plus plenty of hands-on activities for young and old alike. All activities are offered on a donation basis. The proceeds go towards the respective projects. Admission is free.

name: Adventsökomarkt am Kollwitzplatz
old: Wheelchair accessible. Discover a wide variety of sweet and savoury snacks, hot and cold drinks, as well as information stands run by charitable organisations. The Advent Eco-Market promotes a slower-paced, fair and mindful shopping experience as an alternative to the usual Christmas hustle and bustle in Berlin. Every Sunday in Advent offers exciting activities, sustainable gift ideas and information on environmental protection and fair-trade products. Be delighted by numerous surprises and enjoy the contemplative Advent atmosphere in the heart of Prenzlauer Berg.

name: Weihnachtsmarkt "Lichterglanz im Tannenwald" in den Späth'schen Baumschulen
old: The Christmas market is fully accessible, with a disabled-friendly toilet. Rockin’ around the Christmas Tree in a fairytale Christmas wonderland: featuring live bands and Christmas choirs, 100 stalls with gift ideas, Father Christmas and angels, a glitter garden at the Tree Nursery Museum, the Monbijou Theatre and a fairytale storyteller, horse-drawn carriage rides, children’s craft activities, a fire show, hearty winter fare and sweet treats, and a vast forest of Christmas trees. A picture-book Christmas market in the courtyard of the town’s oldest company. Saturdays and Sundays during Advent
